items.title: Bloom Energy (BE) Lands 900 Megawatt Data Center Power Deal In Biggest Overseas Win
items.summary: Bloom Energy (NYSE:BE) announced a new agreement with NTT DATA to deploy 900 megawatts of onsite fuel cell power for global data centers. The NTT DATA partnership is described by Bloom Energy as its largest international agreement to date for data center projects. The deal targets power supply for NTT DATA data centers that support AI-related workloads and address grid and sustainability constraints. This 900 megawatt NTT DATA fuel cell buildout is important, but investors should weigh it...

items.title: Bloom Energy Just Dropped 12% in a Week. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy fell 12% in the past week as Democrats’ midterm sweep sank AI stocks, despite new deals with NTT DATA and California Resources. Bloom made 97% of its third-quarter revenue in the US, so slower US data-center approvals are the main risk, and Oracle’s spending is the thing to watch.

items.title: Google Is Spending $17 Billion on a Wyoming Data Center and Says It Will Pay for 100% of Its Power
items.summary: Google just answered the loudest objection to AI data centers, yet the market barely noticed and one key supplier tumbled. The fine print on who supplies the power, and what the pledge leaves out, may matter more than the headline.
